Criterion: user story expresses exactly one feature. Violation when combines two or more independently implementable/testable/prioritizable features. Do not flag conjunctions merely enumerate attributes of one feature.

We have full backlog. Need classify each. Need be consistent. Let's go through each.

Need parse each story. Atomic individual. If story contains multiple features combined by and, etc. But some "and" may enumerate attributes of one feature or one workflow. Need decide.

Let's list BC-001: anonymous view list of sponsors. One feature. No violation.

BC-002: view list of user profiles. One.

BC-003: trainingcoordinator email all trainers at once from website. One. No.

BC-004: attendee have clear map where buildings/rooms are. One.

BC-005: trainer edit training node myself, so coordinators don't have to and links to slides. "edit my training node myself... and links to slides" This combines editing training node and links to slides? Role trainer wants to edit training node myself and links to slides. Could be two features: edit node and manage links to slides. "and links to slides" ambiguous. Likely violation because edit training node and [add?] links to slides are separate. But maybe "links to slides" as part of training node? The text: "I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." This is syntactically odd. But includes "and links to slides" maybe wants edit training node and links to slides? I'd flag violation. Need evidence.

BC-006: trainee limit one registration per day per authenticated user. One feature (validation/rule). No.

BC-007: trainingcoordinator admin view tracks registration status for each attendee. One. Redundant "so that" but one feature.

BC-008: attendee added to training waitlist. One.

BC-009: trainee must accept cancellation terms with checkbox. One.

BC-010: coordinator tie cancellation deadline to registration/cancellation workflow. One.

BC-013: trainer have view attached to training node shows all attendee info. Contains extra "Trainers can see all class attendance..." but one view. No violation? It is a view. Maybe includes privacy rationale. One feature.

BC-014: admin view where all trainee info shown and can be filtered to show single training session. Is this one feature with filter? Filtering is attribute of view. Not separate feature; no violation.

BC-015: dedicated page for each class with info: Logo, title, trainers, location, map, datetime, skill level, registrations remaining, link to register. And URL SEO. This is a page aggregating many attributes. Criterion says do not flag conjunctions enumerate attributes of one feature. But includes link to register, map view, dedicated page. Is it exactly one feature? "Dedicated page for each class to learn more" includes content items. They are attributes. Also "URL path SEO friendly" may be implementation constraint. I'd likely no violation because one page feature with multiple attributes. Need maybe not flag. But "AND the trainer can tweet and promote their class" maybe includes trainer can tweet? Actually rationale "so that I can choose the right class, AND the trainer can tweet and promote their class." The story includes value for trainer but feature is dedicated page. Not two features. No.

BC-016: training options clearly marked for following information list. One page/list with attributes. No violation. It says "shop for training all with one page AND find their class on one page" maybe same. No.

BC-017: training landing page with intro section and list of all training offerings and promote call for trainings. The user story: "I want to have a training landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings and promote call for trainings, so that I can shop for training all with one page and we can have a call for trainings for selection." This might combine landing page content: intro, list offerings, call for trainings. Could be one landing page with sections. But "promote call for trainings" might be separate (call for trainings). "and promote call for trainings" might be second feature beyond landing page? Need decide. Atomic: one feature exactly. The page includes intro, list all offerings, and promote call for trainings. Probably one "training landing page" with multiple sections. However "promote call for trainings" seems separate objective from "list training offerings." But in same page? It says "with an intro section and a list ... and promote call for trainings" maybe all same page. Could be no violation as one page enumerating components. We'll consider no, likely.

BC-018: link on home page to list training options. One.
